positions.title: Digital Technology Intern
positions.description:
Contributed to an open-source GitHub project enabling Magik language recognition across GitHub.
Communicated with customer employees to clarify requirements and provide optimal support.
Worked closely with a customer to migrate their database to a new version, solving bugs along the way.
Assisted other team members in the resolution of their user stories.

positions.description: Developed multiple modules in application firmware in C, tested both software and hardware's interaction with other parts of the system, characterized complex behavior, and documented results for company reference.

positions.title: Swim Instructor
positions.description: Instructing private swim lessons for children, focusing on water safety and fun. Lessons tailored to each child’s physical and cognitive ability. Experience with children of vary abilities, including ADHD, down syndrome, and autism.
positions.insights: Skills: Instruction · Oral Communication · Leadership · Communication · Organization Skills

volunteerExperiences.description: As a former scout, I take pride in leading a unit of young girls through a week of various activities teaching them how to become competent leaders and to have self confidence. Since volunteering at the age of 12, I have been flexible and carryout many different jobs including leading units, teaching archery, building program material for preceding years, and floating to help where needed.

Welcoming incoming groups of students to the University of Victoria. Providing engaging activities for students to meet one another, leading campus tours, answering questions, helping facilitate move in and residence activities.
